description: This Java class, DesCrypt, provides utility methods for 3DES (Triple DES) encryption and decryption, including key generation, encryption, decryption, and key specification handling.

classes.name: DesCrypt
classes.description: Utility class for doing 3DES encryption, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using a specified key, prepending an IV.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data encrypted with a specified key, extracting IV from payload.

methods.name: getDesKey
methods.description: Constructs a 3DES Key object from raw key bytes.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Cipher instance for encryption or decryption with a given key and IV.
